objective: Complete political world environment art refinement for VIP_EXPRESS (Mitron Express) and RAHULVERSE across all 12 districts adhering to Phase 1 art direction and visual baseline
acceptance_criteria: Ground before mutating: inspect existing SceneryFactory, TrackChunk, WorldScene, VipSatireWorldBuilder, and RahulSatireWorldBuilder
Preserve all existing 12 districts with distinct dominant architectural landmarks and cohesive supporting architecture
Eliminate repetitive extruded box facades by constructing articulated Indian buildings with setbacks, chhatris, jalis, verandas, cornices, awnings, and distinct skylines
Ground all architecture with proper deep foundation plinths (Y <= -4.8m) to prevent floating scenery
Stage comedy focal points within the runner primary visual cone using cantilevered overhead banners, arches, and visible trackside sets (|X| >= 8.5m)
Maintain strict clearance of the gameplay rail corridor (|X| <= 4.5m) and vertical clearance (Y >= 6.2m for overhead arches)
Preserve detail tiers FULL, BALANCED, and MINIMAL, geometry caching, and memory pooling without resource leaks
Pass all existing test suites (vip-express, rahulverse, worldgen, engine-stabilization) and npm run build
Verify live browser gameplay with collisions enabled, proving 60 FPS performance and comparing before/after telemetry
non_goals: Do not modify player physics, jump arcs, slide clearance, speed curves, or lane switching
Do not alter obstacle spawning, train spawning, procedural difficulty, or coin paths
Do not change economy, shop prices, character stats, or HUD mechanics
Do not modify shared engine files without proving a world-local solution is impossible
Do not add extra districts beyond the 6 canonical districts per world

evidence.browser_captures: 76 high-resolution PNG captures + telemetry_report.json generated across all 12 districts
